name: How much does luxury home sale closing coordination cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does luxury home sale closing coordination cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for luxury home sale closing coordination varies based on the complexity of the transaction and the scope of services required. Some real estate agents, like Kelby Contreras at Realty ONE Group Evolution, may offer this as a value-added service within their commission structure for high-end properties. It's important to discuss the specific fee structure and what's included during your initial consultation, as some coordinators charge a flat fee while others may have a percentage-based charge or an hourly rate, reflecting the tailored support needed for luxury sales.
acceptedAnswer.description: The cost of luxury home closing coordination varies by transaction complexity and service scope. Some agents offer it as part of their commission; discuss specific fees during your initial consultation.
